## Apps — Know Your Label (KYL)

- [Apps by Hariom Lohar](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/apps/): Android apps and experiments.
- [Know Your Label (KYL) — AI food label scanner for Android](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/apps/kyl/): By Hariom Lohar. Read ingredients and nutrition from photos; check possible conflicts with saved allergies and dietary preferences. A photo cannot confirm that food is allergy-safe.

## Projects — interactive vs code

- [Project archive (tabs: All / Live / Code)](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects): filtered archive. Live = view+interact in browser. Code = repository only.
- [AGI_Research — Daily log · in progress](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/agi-research/): Public lab notebook — committed daily since July 2026. Linear algebra, calculus and probability from axioms → neural nets and backprop in pure NumPy (SGD through Adam) → now CNNs, Transformers and PyTorch. No shortcuts. Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/AGI_Research
- [micrograd_hk — On PyPI · shipped](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/micrograd-hk/): A tiny autograd engine on NumPy — a Value graph with vectorised backprop and gradient descent, written before touching a framework. Inspired by micrograd, but matrix-driven: pip install micrograd_hk, Colab demo included. Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/micrograd-hk
- [peek — On PyPI · shipped](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/peek/): htop for codebases — understand any repo in five seconds. Languages, size and structure in one screen: pip install peek-code && peek . Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/peek
- [inkdown — v1.1.0 · shipped](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/inkdown/): Notion for Markdown — write in a clean editor, ship plain .md files. Local-first desktop app: no account, no lock-in. Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/inkdown
- [practice_code — Open source](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/practice-code/): 60+ Python solutions for algorithms and data structures, grouped by topic. Each notes time and space. Fork it, add your approach, open a PR. Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/practice_code
- [pkg_jupy — Open source](https://hariomlohardev.github.io/projects/p/pkg-jupy/): Jupyter experiments that grew up — small Python packages, utility notebooks and visualisation scratches. Open for issues and PRs. Repo: https://github.com/hariomlohardev/pkg_jupy
